jobs.occupation: Bioinformatiker (m/w/d) (Bioinformatiker/in)
jobs.description:
The Research Institute Children's Cancer Centre at the University Medical Center Hamburg-Eppendorf is looking for a highly motivated research assistant (PhD student) in the Computational Pediatric Oncology working group (headed by Prof. Dr. Michael Bockmayr) starting 01.11.2026. A later start can be accomodated in principle. We actively support and offer the chance to pursue a PhD alongside the project.
This position is part of a BMFTR-funded Junior Research Consortium conducted in close cooperation with the TU Berlin (Machine Learning Group/Dr. Mina Jamshidi Idaji) and the LMU München (Computational and Molecular Pathology/Prof. Dr. Philipp Jurmeister). The project focuses on developing novel ML methods for multimodal learning in computer-aided diagnostics. The goal is to integrate histopathological, clinical, and molecular data to optimize AI-based decision-making tools in oncology.
Strong individualized support is guaranteed throughout the entire period. In addition, you can expect a motivated and dynamic team of physicians, natural scientists, bioinformaticians, technical assistants, and students at the Research Institute, who are investigating pediatric cancers as part of various projects and with different approaches. Your tasks:

Development and evaluation of clinically relevant multimodal classification algorithms using machine learning methods based on image data and high-dimensional omics datasets
Integration of histological, molecular (genomics, epigenomics, transcriptomics at the bulk and single-cell levels), and clinical data
Close collaboration with partners and other research groups at the Children’s Cancer Center
Presentation of research results at international conferences and publication as first author in recognized journals

This position is temporary for three years due to third-party funding and project duration.
Proven programming experience, especially in Python, good knowledge of ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. Programming experience in R is a plus
Excellent knowledge of current machine learning methods
Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across disciplines
Proficiency in written and spoken English; familiarity with German is a plus
Experience with representation learning, transformer architectures, and explainable AI (XAI) is a plus
Knowledge of omics data processing and basic molecular biology is a plus but not mandatory, as we care more about your computational skills
Knowledge of UNIX-based operating systems and version control software is desirable

We look forward to receiving a detailed application including a letter of motivation, CV, references, degree certificates, transcript of records and, if possible, links to code examples, theses or publications.

jobs.description:
For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:

Scientist for the development of the German EOSC‑Node

Limited: 2 years | Start: earliest possible | ID: FHMA022/2026 | Deadline: 03.10.2026 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The DESY Information Technology (IT) division participates in a wide range of high-profile national and European projects, evaluating and developing innovative IT technologies. One of its key activities is the establishment of the German EOSC Node in collaboration with ten leading research institutions across Germany as part of the National Research Data Infrastructure (NFDI). This initiative requires close coordination across more than 300 German universities and research institutions, as well as with national and European research infrastructures.
To support this ambitious endeavour, we are seeking a scientist with expertise in modern web technologies, particularly the development of user-facing web portals and backend services. The successful candidate will be motivated to contribute to the design, development, and operation of these technologies within the evolving European Open Science Cloud (EOSC) ecosystem.

About your role:

- You will contribute to the overall architecture and the design of the German NFDI EOSC Node
- You will coordinate the selection and methodology for developing a service portfolio compatible with existing requirements for the EOSC Node
- You will enhance and deploy a portal for accessing Web Services for the EOSC Node
- You will ensure that the representation of service records is harmonized and aligned with interoperability specifications in the EOSC
- You will participate in regular project meetings, workshops and conferences, both online and in person, and you will contribute to regular reports towards the project management

About you:

- You have completed a master's degree in computer science, physics or related subjects
- You have good knowledge of Web Technologies and at least one modern programming language
- Familiarity with modern cloud technologies, such as CI/CD and Kubernetes, is beneficial
- Experience with user-facing web portals, REST APIs and/or backend development is a plus
- You have good spoken and written command of the English Ianguage
- You are a collaborative team player who enjoys working in large, international teams
- You are open to travel

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work-life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For further information, please contact Tim Wetzel at +49 40 8998‑2911 (https://tel:+494089982911)  **(Tim.Wetzel@desy.de (https://mailto:Tim.Wetzel@desy.de) ).**

DESY promotes equal opportunities, diversity and inclusion (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/130663/2/2544) . We therefore welcome applications from people of all dimensions of diversity. About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Job description

In order to support the Quality Conformance Management, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Bachelor student (d/f/m) in the field of Quality Management / Behavioral Science, working title of thesis "Quality NC Eradication – Behavioral Quality Management (Nudging)".

You are looking for a bachelor thesis and want to get to know the work of a Quality Conformance Manager? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in Quality department of A320 FAL Hamburg as a Bachelor Student(d/f/m)!

- Location: Hamburg Finkenwerder
- Start: As soon as possible
- Duration: 14 weeks

Your location

You will be working at one of the largest production sites for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Your benefits

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime) and opportunities for mobile working after department agreement.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally (you will be integrated into a young, highly motivated team composed of members from 10 different nationalities).
- Work with modern/diversified technologies and explore the field of nudging and behavioral science inside an operational business.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.

- Analyze human factor challenges, such as shifted attention (Prospective Memory) or underestimating risks (Availability Heuristic).

jobs.occupation: Sustainability Specialist (m/w/d) (Umwelt-Auditor/in)
jobs.description:
ENERCON GmbH
We are seeking a highly motivated Sustainability Specialist to join our team: This position will play a pivotal role in driving various sustainability programs across our worldwide operations, supporting the further development of our sustainability strategy and communicating our sustainability initiatives and successes.
The ideal candidate will have a thorough understanding of the current sustainability landscape, a strong interest for communication and working collaboratively on sustainability programs with different departments - but above all - be passionate about all aspects of sustainability.
Interested in actively shaping the sustainability journey, all while working for the global energy transition? We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Your responsibilities:

- Actively contribute to the implementation, further development and anchoring of ENERCON's company-wide sustainability strategy and related roadmaps, including the identification of gaps, priorities and next steps
- Drive the development of customer-oriented sustainability solutions and value propositions in close collaboration with relevant functions
- Coordinate cross-functional and international working groups to support the implementation, integration and tracking of sustainability initiatives, including circularity initiatives
- Monitor and analyze sustainability-related regulations, market trends, competitor activities and stakeholder expectations to derive actionable recommendations for ENERCON's sustainability strategy, roadmaps and reporting
- Manage the collection, consolidation and quality assurance of selected sustainability steering KPIs for internal steering, decision making and performance tracking
- Lead selected sustainability communications, including the annual sustainability highlight report, and contribute to communication planning for internal and external target groups in close coordination with Corporate Communications and relevant stakeholders

Your qualifications:

- Graduate degree in sustainability or business administration, preferably in the field of circularity, energy, climate change or environment and relevant professional experience in the field of energy, circularity, communication, auditing or consulting
- 3+ years of experience in a position in sustainability
- Strategic and analytical mindset, with the ability to identify gaps, derive priorities and translate sustainability topics into actionable initiatives
- Excellent understanding of sustainability standards, reporting frameworks and regulatory developments, such as CSRD, Circular Economy Act, etc.
- Strong project management skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks, manage deadlines and lead cross-functional initiatives in a collaborative environment
- Clear communication and interpersonal abilities, with the capacity to engage stakeholders at different levels and present complex sustainability topics in an accessible way
- Preferably international work experience and intercultural awareness
- Highly articulate with excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and German
- Willingness to travel to the headquarters in Northern Germany
